dialog.placement: Position of the panel in the viewport or provided container.
dialog.backdropClassName: Additional classes applied to the backdrop surface.
dialog.backdropStyle: Inline styles applied to the backdrop surface.
dialog.open: Whether the dialog is open in controlled usage.
dialog.onOpenChange: Called with the next open state and event details. eventDetails.reason identifies the cause, such as "outside-press" or "escape-key".
dialog.disablePointerDismissal: Prevents outside pointer input from closing the dialog. Escape dismissal remains enabled.
dialog.showCloseButton: Whether to render the built-in close button. Set false to replace it with DialogClose.
dialog.closeButtonLabel: Accessible name for the built-in close button.
dialog.closeButtonDisabled: Whether the built-in close button is disabled.
dialog.container: Portal target; defaults to the document body.
dialog.nestedBackdrop: Render an additional backdrop when this dialog is nested. Does not change dismissal or focus behavior.
dialog.nestedBackdropDescription: Nested dialogs share the outer backdrop by default. Set nestedBackdrop on the child content to dim the parent dialog as well. The child backdrop follows its own open state; dismissal and focus remain managed by Dialog.
dialog.nestedDialogHint: Escape closes only this dialog and returns focus to its trigger.
